address_rule: Every transition preserves the same world address unless the visitor explicitly changes world.

coverage_axes.question: Can retained external material name the subject or publisher it is actually about?
coverage_axes.evidence: publisher/source identity fields plus retained observations
coverage_axes.backfill: PUBLIC_BACKFILL first; unresolved cases remain DISCOVER or HUMAN_VERIFY

coverage_axes.question: Does an observed subject have a lawful first-party Matrix/WebAddress coordinate without implying ownership?
coverage_axes.backfill: address existing observed subjects through their current owner

coverage_axes.question: Does admitted source standing reach the retained material that a subject or territory can actually read?
coverage_axes.evidence: retained items plus admitted/active frontier channels
coverage_axes.backfill: reconcile standing and retained material; never turn discovery into admission

coverage_axes.question: Is dense subject closure precomputed beyond the visible page slice?
coverage_axes.evidence: subject bundles, roots, readers, scenes, actions and dependencies
coverage_axes.backfill: precompute dense subject closure then reconcile readers

coverage_axes.question: Can useful material become account/subject-scoped continuing work rather than a demo or feed card?
coverage_axes.evidence: program instances, source collections, requirements, bindings and continuations
coverage_axes.backfill: recompile affected instances through ProgramFabric; do not auto-prepare a user program

coverage_axes.question: Do live surfaces project the same mature owner closure instead of hand-selected islands?
coverage_axes.evidence: surface scenes, address closure and owner-backed browser witnesses
coverage_axes.backfill: lower from subject/program closure rather than adding page-local state

coverage_axes.question: Do visible actions resolve to exact owners with authority and evidence boundaries intact?
coverage_axes.evidence: subject actions, capability programs, receipts and refusals
coverage_axes.backfill: project existing owner apertures; never manufacture effect authority

coverage_axes.question: Does account-scoped work carry agents, activity, outputs, inbox state and measured usage across products?
coverage_axes.evidence: account task scopes, runs, notifications, outputs and usage receipts
coverage_axes.backfill: project admitted account-scoped runs; missing usage remains not reported

coverage_axes.question: Can every mature projection explain what was observed, derived, admitted and still unresolved?
coverage_axes.evidence: observation, derivation, admission and verification receipts
coverage_axes.backfill: attach existing evidence and preserve unresolved frontiers instead of filling them cosmetically

surfaces.question: What in this world is mine, saved, private, or becoming part of daily life?
surfaces.anonymous_use: A visitor can see the public world; an admitted actor gets the same world narrowed to saved/private relations.
surfaces.effect_aperture: Save, collect, attach a Pack, or create a private note through the exact owner.
surfaces.truth_boundary: personal projection is not ownership of the public subject

surfaces.question: What can be authored, admitted, published, revised, or withdrawn in this world?
surfaces.anonymous_use: Read published material and its provenance without entering an editor.
surfaces.effect_aperture: Create or revise through CMS publication state and owner contracts.
surfaces.truth_boundary: draft or authored content is not public until publication admits it

surfaces.question: What has a person or institution written down about this world, and what evidence does it cite?
surfaces.anonymous_use: Read public notes as publications tied to the same addressed world.
surfaces.effect_aperture: Author a note through PublicationProgram/CMS rather than a free-floating blob.
surfaces.truth_boundary: a note is an authored publication, not evidence merely because it cites evidence

surfaces.question: How can this world be observed, projected, paid, federated, or acted on by machines?
surfaces.anonymous_use: See executable protocol doors and exact carrier/projection status.
surfaces.effect_aperture: Declare or compile a protocol binding; effects remain behind protocol and authority gates.
surfaces.truth_boundary: a protocol candidate or compiled contract is not provider authority or effect permission

surfaces.question: What changed recently enough to matter to a person deciding what to do next?
surfaces.anonymous_use: Immediately answer what is happening, where, how current it is, and what changed.
surfaces.effect_aperture: RSVP/save/follow an admitted occurrence or activate a Pack; do not synthesize an event from source noise.
surfaces.truth_boundary: fresh observation is not a fresh fact and an occurrence is not an offer

surfaces.question: What work turns observations and drafts into an admitted public or operational artifact?
surfaces.anonymous_use: See published outputs and the work lineage that produced them.
surfaces.effect_aperture: Open a purpose-bound authoring or compilation aperture with unresolved human choices only.
surfaces.truth_boundary: a form or work item does not imply an admitted effect

surfaces.question: What did the institution actually observe, when, from where, and what changed?
surfaces.anonymous_use: Inspect exact external observation receipts and temporal disagreement without accepting the source as truth.
surfaces.effect_aperture: Request or retain an observation only through the boundary, lease and source-standing chain.
surfaces.truth_boundary: an observation is evidence of what was observed, not institutional truth

surfaces.question: What is actually offered, quoted, committed, settled, or still merely a candidate in this world?
surfaces.anonymous_use: Compare admitted offers and terms without turning discovered listings into offers.
surfaces.effect_aperture: Quote/accept/settle only through the commerce and commitment owners.
surfaces.truth_boundary: listing or payment presentation does not imply a quote, settlement, fulfillment, or authority

surfaces.question: What coherent situations exist here, and which subjects, conditions, dependencies, and projections make each one a world?
surfaces.anonymous_use: Enter a real situation instead of choosing a product module.
surfaces.effect_aperture: Follow or instantiate only declared world grammars and admitted subjects.
surfaces.truth_boundary: a world projection does not own the subjects it projects

surfaces.question: What real subjects, worlds, sources, capabilities, and nearby joins are worth entering from here?
surfaces.anonymous_use: Land on dense, immediately usable situations ranked by join power rather than a card catalogue.
surfaces.effect_aperture: Follow a candidate into its exact owner; discovery itself performs no external effect.
surfaces.truth_boundary: discovered candidate is not admitted evidence, capability, permission, or truth

surfaces.question: What has been deliberately arranged, compared, or kept together from this world?
surfaces.anonymous_use: Browse public boards that compose existing world fragments rather than copying their truth.
surfaces.effect_aperture: Save/reorder/share through the board owner while source subjects retain their own owners.
surfaces.truth_boundary: curation does not transfer authority or duplicate source truth

surfaces.question: Who is participating around this world, under what membership and governance boundaries?
surfaces.anonymous_use: Read the public body and its rules before joining.
surfaces.effect_aperture: Join, govern, moderate, or publish only where Authority admits the actor.
surfaces.truth_boundary: external social activity is not institution membership

surfaces.question: Which canonical things are being made available, under what terms and validity frontier?
surfaces.anonymous_use: See named available things tied to canonical subjects and current terms.
surfaces.effect_aperture: Create/update availability only through the listing/offer owner.
surfaces.truth_boundary: an external listing candidate is not a canonical or active offer

surfaces.question: Where is this world physically grounded, what is observed there, and as of what time?
surfaces.anonymous_use: Move through places, parcels, routes and spatial observations attached to the same world.
surfaces.effect_aperture: Add an overlay or observation only through spatial/evidence owners.
surfaces.truth_boundary: map coincidence is not identity, ownership, access, or current condition

surfaces.question: What requests, obligations, decisions, commitments, or replies need this actor's attention in this world?
surfaces.anonymous_use: See only public/requestable apertures when anonymous; private obligations stay outside the closure.
surfaces.effect_aperture: Accept, reply, assign, or discharge only through the exact obligation/work owner.
surfaces.truth_boundary: visibility of a request does not authorize its discharge or external effect

surfaces.question: Where is live or threaded conversation around this world admitted, scoped, and moderated?
surfaces.anonymous_use: Read public channels tied to the world without confusing federation with membership.
surfaces.effect_aperture: Speak, moderate, stream, or bridge only through admitted channel capabilities.
surfaces.truth_boundary: a carrier message or federated identity is not institutional speech or membership

surfaces.question: What geographic, institutional, and presentation boundary is being projected right now?
surfaces.anonymous_use: Understand where the current world begins and which lawful projection is being shown.
surfaces.effect_aperture: Change projection/scope without mutating the underlying world.
surfaces.truth_boundary: territory is a view boundary, not ownership of projected subjects

surfaces.question: What occurrences are scheduled, live, past, or becoming actionable in this world?
surfaces.anonymous_use: See time-ordered occurrences with place, current status and provenance.
surfaces.effect_aperture: RSVP/publish/control an occurrence only through admitted apertures.
surfaces.truth_boundary: scheduled occurrence does not imply ticket availability, capacity, safety, or endorsement

surfaces.question: How do people, land, services, governance, work, and commerce compose at neighborhood scale?
surfaces.anonymous_use: Enter the neighborhood as a functioning institution rather than a directory of local pages.
surfaces.effect_aperture: Participate in civic/community/work flows through their separate exact owners.
surfaces.truth_boundary: co-location or community relevance does not create governance authority

surfaces.question: Why is this world in its current state, what is hot, blocked, invalidated, or waiting?
surfaces.anonymous_use: Expose a safe public explanation of freshness/provenance while privileged diagnostics remain gated.
surfaces.effect_aperture: Operators may inspect/retry exact queues and receipts; the console does not become a second owner.
surfaces.truth_boundary: diagnostic state is not semantic authority and a retry is not permission

surfaces.question: What does this world need to stay useful, and which conditions currently activate or freeze that demand?
surfaces.anonymous_use: See why a world wants particular external reality/capabilities and whether those needs are active.
surfaces.effect_aperture: Activate/deactivate declared Pack demand; physical work is reference-counted and source-standing gated.
surfaces.truth_boundary: pack demand is intent, not a fetch, reservation, permission, or fact

surfaces.question: What outside source, provider, protocol, federation, or round-trip is this world connected to, and with what evidence?
surfaces.anonymous_use: Follow provenance from a world subject to the outside thing without collapsing the two identities.
surfaces.effect_aperture: Observe/bind/enact only through ForeignTwin -> DomainProfile -> ProtocolContract owners.
surfaces.truth_boundary: an external link is neither endorsement nor a successful round-trip
